occupancy.decision: Keep16warps for tangent/Adam single-candidate latency. Eightwarps improves the other fused arms but does not beat the v2 K1 execution baseline; no new execution source version retained. Fourwarps is consistently slower. No whole-grid throughput win claimed for tangent.
occupancy.fidelity_limit: Locked selected candidates retain close endpoint validation acrosswarps; very high-LR/long-beta finite poor candidates have large trajectory-sensitive endpoint changes (retained explicitly). This is not whole-grid trajectory equality; no warp-specific accuracy selection or new execution source retained.
